primary_endpoint: DB phase: number of participants with ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement without worsening of NASH, up to 18 months.
efficacy_outcome: Responders: placebo 31, OCA 10 mg 33, and OCA titrated to 25 mg 37; p=0.6172 and p=0.4184 for the reported comparisons.
safety_signal: OLE AE/SAE outcome counts were reported as 199/213/197 and 26/50/48 across the three groups; the source excerpt does not identify which count set corresponds to each event category.
